english.title: Procure inclusion of tobacco advertisement in information society service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..) procured the inclusion of a tobacco advertisement in an information society service by means of which, provided in the course of a business, it had been published in

(A)_[the United Kingdom]_
(B)_[an EEA State other than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..), by a service provider established in the United Kingdom]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3A(2)(b) and 16(2) of the Tobacco Advertising and Promotion Act .

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
